def fetch_all_contacts(rel, access_token, page_limit=20):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=access_token, relationship=rel, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        if len(page)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    return results

# Fetch all pending received Venmo payment requests and filter by sender email
pending_requests=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    pending_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

print('pending_requests_total', len(pending_requests))

# Build allowed email set from roommates and coworkers
allowed_emails=set(coworker_emails) | set(roommate_emails)
print('allowed_emails_count', len(allowed_emails))

matching=[r for r in pending_requests if r.get('sender',{}).get('email') in allowed_emails]
print('matching_pending_requests_count', len(matching))

# Print matching request ids and senders for verification
for r in matching:
    sender=r.get('sender',{})
    print('match', r.get('payment_request_id'), sender.get('email'), r.get('amount'))

# verification: re-fetch pending requests and ensure none of these ids remain pending
pending_after=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    pending_after.extend(page)
    if len(page)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

pending_after_ids=set(r.get('payment_request_id') for r in pending_after)
intersection=pending_after_ids & set(allowed_ids)
print('pending_after_total', len(pending_after))
print('pending_after_intersection_with_target', len(intersection), sorted(intersection))
